scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix frontend run build
